hero.headline: Privacy Built into the Fabric of Our Facility
hero.subheadline: We provide a secure, legally compliant environment where your proprietary models and datasets remain your exclusive property.

sections.title: Our Commitment to Digital Sovereignty
sections.body: At Kenya AI Compute, we view data privacy as a fundamental engineering requirement, not just a legal obligation. Operating under the robust Kenya Data Protection Act (2019)—which is functionally aligned with the EU's GDPR—we ensure that your intellectual property is protected by international-grade legal standards. We maintain a strict 'No-Access' policy for our engineering staff to client server environments, unless explicitly authorized through our ticketing system. Every administrative action within our management network is logged and auditable. We do not engage in data harvesting or model training on client data. In our facility, you are the sole owner of your 'compute results,' and we provide the physical and logical isolation necessary to protect that value from both external and internal threats. sections.title: Core Privacy Principles
items: Zero Data Harvesting: Your models and training data are never used for our internal research.
Hardware Isolation: Option for physically separated server and network hardware (Private Cloud).
Auditable Access: Comprehensive logging of all physical and logical entries to the data halls.
Encryption Enforced: Mandatory encryption for all data-at-rest in our managed storage tiers.
Compliance Ready: Our policies facilitate your own GDPR and SOC 2 audits.
